purpose: Wordless selection-screen illustrations; transparent all-ages ink and watercolor artwork.
encoding: Runtime copies are full-resolution lossless WebP with original RGBA pixels preserved.

assets.name: easel
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished standalone illustrated UI asset for Studioodle, a welcoming all-ages coloring and drawing studio. Subject: a charming wooden artist's easel holding a large inviting, mostly blank cream drawing pad. Actual transparent background, full object comfortably within frame, no scenery, no ground shadow, no text, letters, labels or watermark.

Art direction: expressive hand-inked line art with elegant varied charcoal-blue contours, restrained warm watercolor/gouache washes and soft dimensional shading inside the object. A refined storybook illustration for adults and children, not a flat geometric icon and not a photorealistic render. Palette: ivory paper, warm honey wood, muted watery teal, a little peach/coral and soft gold. Clean readable silhouette at small UI sizes.

The PAPER is the hero: supple, gently bowed toward the viewer with an irregular natural edge and one upper sheet lifting in a graceful sweeping curl, turning over the top and falling behind the pad. Show paper flexibility and a clearly visible reverse surface of the turned sheet; no rigid top cap, no metal rings or spiral binding. A little air between the turning sheet and the front sheet. The substantial blank front sheet has only one beautiful teal paint swoosh, leaving most of the paper open for imagination. A coral-handled paintbrush rests diagonally near its edge, with a few tiny teal/gold magical ink sparkles suggesting you can create anything.

The easel has believable three-quarter perspective, two front legs and one receding rear leg, tactile wood grain, a shallow visible tray supporting the lower edge of the pad and a slim front lip. Paper sits ON the tray. Asymmetrical, lively, softly curved forms, fine confident lines; avoid stiff symmetry, thick blue backing panels, rectangular floating cards, cutesy faces, excessive decorative clutter. Single centered object filling about 85% of a square composition.

assets.name: coloring-book
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone illustrated UI asset for Studioodle, a welcoming all-ages drawing and coloring studio. Subject: an inviting OPEN COLORING BOOK with distinctly asymmetrical curling pages, drawn as beautiful expressive hand-inked line art with restrained watercolor/gouache washes. Actual TRANSPARENT background, no scenery, no ground shadow, no text, letters, logos, captions or watermark. Entire object comfortably in frame. Landscape-shaped book centered within a square composition, filling about 85% of the width.

Match a refined storybook art style: fine confident charcoal-blue outlines with natural variation, ivory paper texture, soft dimensional shading inside the object, watery muted teal, peach/coral and small golden accents. Not a stiff geometric icon, not a photorealistic photograph, not a glossy 3D toy, not overly childish. Readable as an open coloring book at a 180–300 pixel display size.

IMPORTANT ASYMMETRY: viewed from slightly above in a gentle three-quarter angle. It is opened well past its midpoint: a thick soft fan of MANY pages on the LEFT and only a FEW pages on the RIGHT, different page-block thicknesses, unequal visible page widths. The thinner right side lifts up with one corner curling gracefully, showing the reverse of a page. The left side lies lower and more open. A naturally curved gutter and bowed page surfaces; irregular hand-drawn flowing paper edges, no mirrored halves. No thick blue/green cover or solid colored backing panel; only thin cream paper layers and a discreet coral fabric bookmark.

The visible coloring artwork is charming flowing botanical/fantasy line art: a large butterfly among curling wildflowers and leaves, with small stars. Some petals, a butterfly wing and a few leaves have been painted softly in teal, warm coral and golden yellow; MOST of the interior shapes remain white, clearly inviting the user to color them. Both pages contain coherent, readable coloring art following the paper's curve. A coral coloring pencil rests loosely along the lower outside edge. A couple of tiny gold/teal sparkles, no excessive floating decorations. Convey discovery and creative possibility, with lively folds and believable book construction.
